title: A sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on a qcqs scheme is a filtered colimit of constructible ones
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring, and let $F$ be a sheaf of $\Lambda_X$-modules on the small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then $F$ is a filtered colimit of constructible sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]: there are a small filtered category $\mathcal A$, a diagram $\alpha\mapsto F_\alpha$ from $\mathcal A$ to $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ with every $F_\alpha$ constructible, and morphisms $a_\alpha:F_\alpha\to F$ of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules forming a colimit cocone $(F,(a_\alpha)_\alpha)$ of the diagram in $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. (Stacks states this for any Noetherian ring $\Lambda$; it is stated here for finite $\Lambda$, the generality of [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. The special case of $X$ of finite type over a field is [lem-kun-03sa].)

source.place: Lemma 03SA (lemma-torsion-colimit-constructible), part (3), and its proof ('The proofs of (2) and (3) are identical to the proof of (1)'), etale-cohomology.tex line 12216

proof.text: Constructible Lambda-module sheaves generate Mod(X_Et,Lambda): by the constructible generation lemma, choose an epimorphism from a coproduct of constructible sheaves onto F. The finite-presentation property of each constructible sheaf ensures that maps from it into a filtered colimit factor through one stage and become equal after a common refinement.

Let A be the category whose objects are pairs (G,u) with G constructible and u:G -> F, and whose morphisms commute with the maps to F. The preceding generation and finite-presentation statements imply that A is nonempty, any two objects admit a common refinement, and parallel morphisms become equal after a further refinement; thus A is filtered. The canonical cocone from A to F is a colimit: a compatible family of maps out of the G's descends uniquely through the epimorphism coproduct -> F, and uniqueness follows from local epimorphism detection.

source.place: Lemma 03SA, proof of (1), final paragraph; Categories, Lemma 04AX on filtered categories

proof.text: The same construction is internal to Lambda-module sheaves because Lambda is finite and all maps in the diagram are Lambda-linear. Therefore the colimit cocone is a colimit in Mod(X_Et,Lambda), and every object of the filtered diagram is constructible, which proves the assertion.
